business_summary.text: Menon Bearings Limited manufactures auto components including bi-metal bearings, aluminium die castings, and brake systems for automotive and engineering sectors

call_points.text: FY27 revenue guidance maintained at ₹360 Cr, management expects potential upside
₹9-10 Cr CapEx for bi-metal capacity expansion, 25-30% increase
CapEx to be funded through internal accruals, no fresh debt
Monsoon impact on tractor segment expected to improve by next month

penalties.details: For Delay in filing of Shareholding pattern under Regulation 31(1) of Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements , 2015 by 4 days fine amount levied Rs. 8000/- GST

guidance.statement: EV share in Alkop by FY27 end

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Automobile and Auto Components > Auto Components > Auto Components & Equipments

operating_notes.text: Brakes segment achieved 25% EBITDA margin in Q1FY27, above industry average
Bi-metal capacity utilization at 80%, with third shift capacity available
Aluminium realization increased to ₹900+ due to higher raw material costs

timeline.summary: Menon Bearings reported Q1FY27 results with record revenue of ₹91.79 Cr, up 36.6% YoY, and announced plans for capacity expansion and new market entry
